ui.compact_prov.touch_hint: Armies remain selected. Tap Order 1× (or hold a province) to march, or tap ocean to deselect.
mobile.tap.select_tip:
Select — tap to pick a country, region, or army.
Drag to pan · Hold a province to issue a quick order.
mobile.tap.order_once_tip:
Order 1× — next tap issues 1 march or context order
(like Right-Click) and returns to Select.
Tap again while active to lock multi-order mode.
mobile.tap.order_lock_tip:
Order Lock — every tap issues a march or context order
without returning to Select.
Tap again or pick Select to exit.
mobile.tap.box_tip:
Box — drag one finger to draw a selection box over armies.
Drag with two fingers to pan or zoom the map.
mobile.tap.pan_tip:
Pan — move and zoom the map safely.
Taps never select units or issue orders.
ui.prestige.dossier_tip_fmt:
Prestige: {0} / 1,000 (equilibrium {1})
Grows with economy, living standards, technology, grand projects, allies, subjects, and deterrence; falls with notoriety, instability, and broken treaties.
ui.prestige.ranking_formula_fmt: Index: GDP {0}% · population {1}% · ground power {2}% · technology {3}% · prestige {4}%.
ui.prestige.ranking_formula_tip: Each component is divided by the largest visible value. Ground power is a public national aggregate, not a report of unit locations. Fleets and aircraft are not included. Prestige reflects diplomacy, GDP, tech, and standing. Living standards are a separate comparison. Landless countries are excluded. Weights are moddable in game/interface.
